Another week almost down a few things that stood out in camp… 

i don’t know about the rest of you all but every year I become more and more of a believer in Jordan Love. Really impressed with his improvement as a player and definitely as a leader and how he is in the locker room. He’s definitely elite enough to win it one year. But that depends a lot on who’s around him
